items.item_text: High school diploma (e.g. HiSET or GED)
Experience using Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and other social media platforms.

The UCLA Blood & Platelet Center is seeking a motivated Student Marketing & Social Media Coordinator to support marketing initiatives that increase blood donor recruitment, awareness, and community engagement.
Develop, schedule, and manage content across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, LinkedIn, and other social media platforms.
Create engaging graphics, videos, reels, stories, and promotional materials.
Assist with donor recruitment campaigns, campus outreach, and special events.
Collaborate with Blood & Platelet Center staff to develop and implement marketing strategies that increase donor participation.
Monitor social media performance metrics and provide recommendations to improve engagement and audience growth.
Note: This is a student worker position and is open exclusively to current UCLA students.
Must be a current UCLA student.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Knowledge of the blood donation process - preferred
